description: Costco Wholesale Corporation operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites based on the concept that offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products in a wide range of categories will produce high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover. Combined with the operating efficiencies achieved by volume purchasing, efficient distribution and reduced handling of merchandise in no-frills, self-service warehouse facilities, these volumes and turnover enable it to operate profitably at significantly lower gross margins than most other retailers, and it often sells inventory before it is required to pay for it while taking advantage of early payment discounts. It reports on a 52/53-week fiscal year ending on the Sunday nearest the end of August, and its ancillary businesses include gas stations, food courts, pharmacies, optical and hearing services and tire installation.
